Received an outstanding service from Anthony from the first time I contacted his services. Came the same day and his prices are very reasonable. Installed my 72” fan within half an hour. He is very knowledgeable of his work. Will highly recommend him to everyone.

He was also quick, efficient, and kind. I will be calling him going forward for any repairs and improvements in our home!
